articles.summary: Amnesty International USA and the ACLU issued a report last month purporting to document what they describe as an illicit crackdown on "pro-Palestine" expression since October 7. Needless to say, I think the problem has primarily been the opposite , university officials and local politicians and prosecutors being far too indulgent of illicit behavior by Hamasnik protestors, including vandalism, threats, disruptions, harassment and violence.
